Open questions

  • Should the ledger also show net 'who owes whom' balances (display only), or only each person's share per expense and per month?
  • Does the away flatmate pay maintenance or other fixed bills, or only rent and WiFi?
  • How should a member who leaves the flat for good settle up? Does the ledger need a 'settled' marker?

Known issues

  • No screenshots for Phases 1–5 or the sign-in change (built before this log existed).
  • No section's 'done when' criterion in SPEC §11 has been checked with real use yet (a week of chores, a month of money, 20 real bills).
  • §12 cases are covered by unit tests on the engine functions; there are no end-to-end UI tests.
  • The menu plan (Order in / We'll cook) is still one choice per day, even when the cook misses only one meal.
  • GROQ_API_KEY is not set in production or locally: bill scanning has no fallback if Gemini fails.
  • Bill scanning has not been tested on the production site. Push: functions now start (secrets uploaded 6 Nov) but no phone has subscribed yet, so delivery is untested.
  • Seven unused test domains (letscohabit, getcohabit, cohabithq, cohabito, cohabby, cohabiting, ourcohabit .vercel.app) are still attached to the Vercel project; remove them in Settings → Domains.
  • Sample logins use one shared sample password on the live site. Remove or change them before real use.
  • First tap on a tab still waits for one server trip (~0.35 s). Prefetching signed-in data would need "use cache: private" data caching; not done.
  • A visited tab can show data up to 60 s old when another flatmate changes something (your own saves refresh at once).
  • If you were signed out on your phone, likely causes were switching between tenant-plum.vercel.app and wecohabit.vercel.app (separate cookies) or the 30-day expiry. Not reproduced on desktop Chromium.
  • Deleting a whole flat that has chore duties fails in the database (the "skipped duty has no member" rule trips while members are removed). The app has no delete-flat feature; found while cleaning up test data.
  • The new error page (app/error.tsx) is in place but wasn't seen in a browser test: a dropped request already recovers through Next's full-page fallback, and a real server crash can't be injected into a production build.
  • With service workers blocked (some in-app/private browsers), the Serwist library logs "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'waiting')"; pages still work.
  • The daily chore job runs from pg_cron using two Vault values (supabase/.vault-setup.sql, run once in the Supabase SQL editor). Not verified that they exist; if not, the schedule still doesn't fire (pages create the day's duties when opened).
  • VAPID_SUBJECT is still the placeholder mailto:you@example.com.
  • UI polish: every main screen is done; the New split and Scan a bill forms (and the single chore, away and member edit forms) keep the older form layout.
  • Today's duties are created when a page first opens, so the very first load of the day can show 'Nothing for you today' until a refresh (seen while taking screenshots; existing behaviour).
  • PDF bills have no fallback reader: Groq only reads images (and GROQ_API_KEY isn't set). If Gemini fails, use a photo or New split.
  • New scanned expenses no longer keep a bill picture, so the expense page can't show the original bill for them.
  • Edit chores saves chore by chore: if the connection drops mid-save, some chores can be saved and others not (re-saving fixes it).

Decisions

  • 2026-11-05 — Design direction: the SPEC §6.1 mockup tokens (Manrope, #F5F4EF background, #0F6E64 accent, 16px cards, Lucide-style icons). design-taste-frontend is not installed, so this direction is kept for every later section.
  • 2026-11-05 — Sign-in uses Tenant's own username and password accounts, not Supabase Auth.
  • 2026-11-05 — Bill scanning runs on free tiers only: Gemini Flash first, Groq Llama 4 Scout as fallback.
  • 2026-11-05 — Project log was set up by hand: the section-status-artifact and section-sync-check skills are not installed.
  • 2026-11-05 — Part-day away: slots (morning/afternoon/night) for a single day; they only change meals. Chores and money treat the person as home. Breakfast added to the menu.
  • 2026-11-06 — Sample data lives in the live flat (C2 102) because local and production share one Supabase project. Remove it with npm run seed:sample -- --remove (this also clears ALL chores, menu, away periods and expenses in that flat). Danielraj joined_on moved to 1 Aug 2026 so September bills include them.
  • 2026-11-06 — Vercel functions run in sin1 (vercel.json) to sit next to Supabase ap-southeast-1. Sessions slide: 180 days, renewed by the proxy at most once a day.
  • 2026-11-06 — Joining: flat code + admin approval (join_requests). The open invite link and join_flat/invite_preview were removed because they skipped approval.
  • 2026-11-06 — Removing a member: with any history (bills, shares, duties, away days) they get left_on = yesterday (or their join day) and lose rotation, push and menu-owner; without history they are deleted. Re-joining reuses their old member row.
  • 2026-11-06 — Moments that change flat membership (creating a flat, being accepted) use a full page load, so pages cached by the 60 s tab cache are not reused.
  • 2026-11-06 — Own-data permissions: away days (own + cook/maid leave), splits (creator) and duties (person on duty); the admin can change anyone's. Chores themselves (add/edit/delete) are still open to every flatmate.
  • 2026-11-06 — Mary replaces Lakshmi as cook from 6 Nov (Lakshmi left 5 Nov). Cook's pay adds up days worked across every cook employed in the month.
  • 2026-11-06 — Usual skips are per person (breakfast/lunch/dinner), set by each person for themselves; only meal headcounts use them. Admin hand-over is one transaction: the new admin gains, the old one loses admin.
  • 2026-11-06 — Maid's pay is cut for full days off, like the cook's (user's choice). expense_categories.staff_role says whose days a pay-by-days split counts.
  • 2026-11-07 — UI improvement: the user chose to polish the current look (Manrope, cream, teal from SPEC §6.1) rather than a new direction. Plan: 1 shared components + nav + Today, 2 Calendar + Chores, 3 Menu + Money, 4 Settings, sign-in and onboarding.
  • 2026-11-07 — Bills (photo or PDF) are read by the AI and not stored (user's choice). expenses.bill_image_path stays for older scanned expenses. PDFs: Gemini only, max 4 MB (Vercel's 4.5 MB request limit).
  • 2026-11-09 — Week menu: one planner screen; Copy last week and Use usual menu overwrite only days from today on and can be undone before saving. The usual menu is one per flat (menu_templates, weekday 1–7), saved from the planner's checkbox. Chores and menu keep the current permission rules (user's choice).
  • 2026-11-09 — Edit chores screen: days picked as chips, frequency derived (7 days = daily, 1 = weekly, else custom). Saving checks every chore first, then writes; the writes are separate statements, not one transaction.
  • 2026-11-09 — UI polish sections 2–4 kept the SPEC §6.1 direction (Manrope, cream, teal). Desktop pattern: data-wide pages with two columns, sticky left column where it helps; phone layouts unchanged in structure. Own highlights use a teal outline, not a tinted fill, so avatars and pills keep contrast.

    • 2026-11-06 — Faster pages and staying signed in

  • Cause: functions ran in iad1 (US East) while Supabase is in ap-southeast-1 (Singapore), ~220 ms per query, several queries per page in a row.
  • vercel.json regions → sin1. getFlatContext and loadChoreWeek now query in parallel.
  • staleTimes.dynamic = 60: a visited tab is reused for a minute; saves still revalidate at once.
  • Sliding sessions: 180 days, renewed by the proxy on use (3 new tests, 147/147 pass).
  • Live from India: full page 1.5–2.6 s → 0.6–0.75 s; tab first tap ~0.35 s, revisit ~0.05 s. Sign-in survives a browser restart.
